# Video formats

| Format | What it looks like | Use it for | Shoot directions |
|---|---|---|---|
| `raw-talking-head` | You, to camera, tight cuts, captions | Buyer questions, myth busts, offers | Eye level, window light in front of you. Say the hook first, in one breath |
| `popup-presenter` | You to camera with key words popping in | Frameworks, client wins with numbers, lists | Leave a little space on one side of the frame. Pause half a second between points |
| `split-demo` | Top half you, bottom half a screen recording | Showing a tool, a template or a worked example | Record the screen separately; narrate as if pointing at it |
| `news-greenscreen` | You in front of a headline screenshot | News takes, within 24 hours of the story | Plain background behind you. Have the headline open so you can read the key line |
